faqLeft.q: What engines does the Mercedes GLE Coupe use?
faqLeft.a: The GLE Coupe shares its engine range with the standard GLE. Depending on the variant and year, it can have the OM642 3.0-litre V6 diesel, OM656 3.0-litre I6 diesel, M256 3.0-litre I6 petrol MHEV, M176 4.0-litre V8 twin-turbo, or M157/M177 AMG V8. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLE Coupe engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800 for the diesel variants, £3,200 for petrol MHEV, £4,500 for the M176 V8, and £6,500 for the AMG V8. Exact price depends on your engine code, condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLE Coupe?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code — whether it's OM642, OM656, M256, M176, M157 or M177 — before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 GLE Coupe engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM656 GLE Coupe engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The OM656 is a newer diesel with no independently confirmed issues for this application, and we service it to the same standard as our other GLE Coupe rebuilds.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M256 GLE Coupe engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M256 is the 3.0-litre petrol MHEV unit fitted to the GLE450 and GLE53 AMG Coupe models, and we cover it fully.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild M176 GLE Coupe engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M176 is the 4.0-litre V8 twin-turbo fitted to the GLE580 Coupe.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild M157/M177 GLE Coupe engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. We inspect and replace valve seals and coolant components as standard on every AMG V8 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLE Coupe engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLE Coupe if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLE Coupe engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLE Coupe owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
